jpn-dojo-default-11.things: A wall-mounted kamidana (Shinto altar) on the north wall, a full suit of samurai armor on a stand in the northeast corner, four wooden weapon racks (two along the west wall, two along the east wall), a wooden slatted entrance gate in the south wall, two small low stands in the southwest and southeast corners, and an open wooden plank floor in the center.
jpn-dojo-default-11.focal: None (open central training floor, oriented toward the kamidana on the north wall)

jpn-garden-default-11.room: Japanese tea room and garden (chashitsu and roji)
jpn-garden-default-11.things: A walled tea room at the north end features tatami flooring, a folding screen in the northwest corner, a tokonoma alcove with a flower vase and scroll on the north wall, a wooden shelving unit on the east wall, and a low tea table with a tea set and floor cushion in the center. An outdoor garden to the south is enclosed by a bamboo fence, containing a line of five round stone stepping stones, a stone lantern and water basin with a bamboo ladle beside the path, and two stylized trees along the eastern edge.
